From the source polarities in the figure, take the upper node potential V_top = 16 V, the lower-end node potential of R3 V_lower = 7 V, and the point B potential V_B = 12 V. Since terminal A is open-circuited, there is no current in R1, so there is no voltage drop across R1, and V_A equals the divider node potential between R2 and R3.
